trap.label: to + substantivo
trap.wrong: Estimates may be subject to revise.
trap.right: Estimates may be subject to revision.
trap.why: Em português “sujeito a revisar” usa infinitivo. Em inglês, to em subject to é preposição: pede substantivo (revision) ou -ing.

mcq.q: “___ to funding, the study will continue.”

fix.wrong: Responses are subject for memory error.
fix.right: Responses are subject to memory error.

fix.wrong: The study will continue subject funding.
fix.right: The study will continue subject to funding.

fix.wrong: The survey may be subject to bias error.
fix.right: The survey may be subject to error.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com subject to: “Memory error may affect responses.”
rewrite.answer: Responses may be subject to memory error.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Subject to: “If funding exists, the study will continue.”
rewrite.answer: Subject to funding, the study will continue.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com revision: “We may revise the estimates.”
rewrite.answer: The estimates may be subject to revision.
